tools.name: list_failed_syncs
tools.description: List unresolved Shopify-to-ERP sync failures. Each record includes a deterministic triage: likely root cause, suggested fix, and whether that fix is on the safe auto-apply whitelist.

erp.description: Optional filter: Cin7, Unleashed, MYOB, Xero, NetSuite, QuickBooks, DATEV.

tools.name: get_shopify_order
tools.description: Fetch the Shopify order (line items, SKUs, tax, country) behind a failed sync.

tools.name: get_erp_item
tools.description: Look up an item in the ERP by SKU/code (respects existing SKU mappings). Returns on-hand stock by location.

tools.name: map_sku
tools.description: Create a permanent mapping from a Shopify SKU to an existing ERP item code. Requires human approval.

tools.name: retry_sync
tools.description: Retry a failed sync, optionally applying a named fix. Whitelisted fixes (trim_sku_whitespace, normalize_country_code, round_tax_2dp, skip_duplicate, retry_transient) run immediately; any other fix returns pending_approval.

tools.name: post_slack
tools.description: Post the triage summary to the client's ops Slack channel. Max 3500 characters.
